text: APPROVE. The extracted helpers keep the original conditions exactly (`Key == || Universal` is the negation of `Key != && !Universal`) and evaluate the declaration checks in the same order with the same short-circuiting. Complexity drops to about 7 (and about 3 for `ReplacesIndicator`), with no new names or constructs that would plausibly trip warnings-as-errors.
